items.title: How Lindblad is racing ‘for my five-year-old self’ in F1
items.content: Arvid Lindblad may only be half a year into his Formula 1 career, but he has already made an impression – the British teenager going wheel-to-wheel with World Champions from the outset, frequently reaching Q3 and scoring points, and helping to push the Racing Bulls squad up the grid.

summaries.en: Arvid Lindblad, a British teenager in his first year of Formula 1, has quickly made an impact. items.title: From boyband to leading man – Button’s fashion evolution
items.content: 20 years on from Jenson Button’s first Grand Prix victory in Hungary, here’s how the 2009 World Champion’s style evolved throughout his career.
items.contentSnippet: 20 years on from Jenson Button’s first Grand Prix victory in Hungary, here’s how the 2009 World Champion’s style evolved throughout his career.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 杰森·巴顿自2009年匈牙利首次赢得一级方程式胜利以来，其时尚风格经历了20年的演变。作为2009年世界冠军，他的着装风格从早期男孩团体成员的休闲风格，逐渐转变为赛车手的职业形象，再到如今作为领先者的成熟时尚。这一过程反映了他在赛车领域的成长与变化。
summaries.en: Jenson Button, the 2009 Formula 1 World Champion, has seen a significant evolution in his fashion style over 20 years since his first Grand Prix victory. The article highlights this transformation, tracing his style from his boyband days to his current status as a leading figure. While the content focuses on his fashion journey, specific details about his early and later styles are not provided.
